name: SendToDrive
description: A public upload page that drops files straight into a chosen Google Drive folder. Uploaders do not need a Google login, and you do not share Drive access. Used for client docs, assignments, event photos. Pricing (company-stated): 24h trial, Premium €3.96 billed annually, Business $9.99/workspace/month. Founded Jul 2023 (US).

mentions.evidence: ~$1,518 MRR, 314 active subscriptions, ~$1,871 L30, ~$9,529 last 12 months, ~$9,854 all-time. 4,668 visitors L30, about $0.40/visitor (snapshot). Revenue synced Oct 14, 2026 ~06:50 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: Find a missing feature in Google Workspace, Dropbox or OneDrive and ship it as a tiny paid wrapper with SEO landing pages.

whyItPrints: Google never shipped a proper file request for consumer Drive. A thin wrapper fills that gap and claims 95% profit margin (TrustMRR snapshot).
whyThisMatters:
Google Drive still has no simple file request for a normal account. SendToDrive is that page. You connect Google, pick a folder, and share a link or a QR code. The other person uploads in a browser. They do not need a Google login, and they cannot browse the folder. The files land where you pointed. A paid page can add a password, an email whitelist, separate fields for each document, your own branding, an expiry date, and subfolders chosen from the form answers. A workspace plan adds teammates and a short review status. Paddle is the merchant of record, and tax is calculated at checkout.

The free try is one page for a day. Premium is a low annual price for one person. Business is a monthly workspace with two seats included, and extra seats cost more. The founder, Ari, built it after his mother had to collect student work over a chat app during COVID and the phone filled up. The examples on the site run from wedding photos and class assignments to client briefs, job applications, and artwork for a print shop.

You pay so a client can drop a file in your Drive without you handing over the folder.
